environment.description: ECS Fargate service running the SQS consumer in a private subnet. The SQS queue has a resource policy allowing SendMessage from any principal within the AWS account (Principal: '*' with Condition aws:PrincipalOrgID matching the org). Any authenticated IAM entity in the organization can publish messages to the queue. The container runs as root with no seccomp profile. No input sanitization middleware exists between the queue and the consumer.

config.sqs_policy: Allow SendMessage from any principal in org
config.network: Private subnet, NAT gateway for outbound
